cameraFix: Retain negotiated auxiliary RTX when preferring H.264; restores repair and SFU padding probes. Same-deadline no-RTX negative control stalls; final build passes five full suites and three delayed cycles.

gallery.review: All contact-sheet groups reviewed during polish. Final merged featured phone, 412 profile/roles, desktop settings and keyboard/safe-area captures rechecked; no layout changes from merge.

idle.note: Whole separate headless Chromium process-tree totals; working-set sum double-counts shared pages. Not native-client or physical-phone memory.

cleanup.result: Execution policy rejected the command. Target remains; no alternate deletion attempted. Resolved literal path and non-reparse attributes checked; task executables stopped before attempt.

limitations: Physical iOS/Android devices and physical camera/microphone quality were not certified; browser tests use synthetic capture and real SFU.
Server does not implement global notification defaults; unsupported scope hidden, supported per-conversation/server settings retained.
Role member counts show a plus for partial rosters rather than falsely reporting an exact count.
Lighthouse cold authenticated chat remains about 4.5 seconds on shared Windows host; no claim of instant cold startup.
Merged custom emoji/search/slowmode/folders server/client-core/desktop implementation retained; web text_features:false handshake retained as supplied by master.
historicalEvidence: historical-evidence.json identifies intentional negative controls and superseded runs; zero-padded full-suite files are the final merged runs.
safety: Headless only; loopback binds; no visible windows, external OAuth, hardware audio, UAC or git push.
